mechanism.generality: Operation, binding identity and data-flow admission for ordinary top-level numeric loops, independent of source, loop shape, iteration count or benchmark identity. No change to slot-indexed locals or shared-cell ownership. Re-pinning restores the repository-wide hot-code layout invariant; no workload-specific runtime recognition is added.

Guard failure must publish completed stores and replay the failing instruction exactly
Direct eval and dynamic environments must decline; try-containing loops need hang guards
Keep publication out of hot dispatch arms to avoid executor codegen regressions
